en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a wintry cityscape with snowy trees and paths in the foreground and a fortified round tower on the left. Several church spires rise on the hill behind, and a tall, narrow church tower dominates the right side. Handwritten text appears over the sky area and along the bottom margin. Printed German caption and publisher information are visible at the bottom edge.
